title: Android TabWidget: weighted tabs
purpose: Check that fixed-width Android XML tab indicators divide available space according to layout_weight.
changes: Fixed-width tabs now use positive layout_weight values to distribute remaining width, with optional weightSum. This XML example uses zero-width tabs weighted 1:2:1 and margins around the first tab.
steps: Turn on Weighted tabs example. Second should be twice as wide as First and Third; First and Third should have the same width.
Turn on Narrow widget. The tabs should become narrower while keeping those proportions and the first tab's margins.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and verify the order reverses. Tap a tab to check selection.
Choose OK if it works, or Reject with details and your device.
expected: The 1:2:1 proportions hold at both widget widths and in RTL; tabs remain selectable.
limits: This covers fixed-width children. Wrap-content and match-parent sizing, Android's preliminary measurement of zero-width weighted children, rounding and device appearance remain approximate or unverified.

references.scope: Horizontal layout weight and remaining-space distribution.

validation: Twelve TabWidget Rust tests, seven TabHost tests and 156 XML importer tests passed.
A 320 × 700 browser test checked proportions, selection, narrow layout and RTL.
